messages:
maia: quick check — ran a small sweep of speculative decoding + 8-bit quant on the new M3-13B Q30 build (prefetch heuristic alpha). results are noisy but interesting. latency went down a lot, quality hit is non-uniform. sharing numbers below.

ravi: drop the numbers? curious about per-task breakdown.

maia: TL;DR: avg token latency from ~210ms -> ~125ms (speculative fraction ~0.55). TriviaQA F1 -1.1, HotpotQA EM -2.7, summarization ROUGE-L -0.6. failure modes look concentrated on long-context multi-hop answers and chains with constrained facts.

alex: do we have top-k distribution shifts? speculative can introduce earlier tokens with slightly higher prob mass. could be quantization amplifying that.

maia: yep ran small probe: KL(p_full || p_spec_q) per-position spiked at position 2-6 in multi-hop prompts. median KL ~0.03 for single-step QA, ~0.18 for long-hop prompts.

dina: that matches what we saw on the 70B onboard — early token bias after quant + speculative. any evidence of kv-cache staleness vs sampling mismatch?

maia: hypothesis: when speculative injects tokens and we later rescore with quantized model, the logits landscape tilts; quantization nonlinearity pushes alternate high-prob tokens over threshold. so speculative acceptance becomes sticky. also cache reuse across shard boundaries might be slightly stale for long contexts.

ops-bot: deploy-note: canary m3-13b-q30/spec-alpha rolled to dedicated pool 4 at 09:12 UTC.

ravi: suggested experiments: (1) run deterministic argmax (no sampling) to isolate quant bias, (2) increase speculative rollback budget (lower acceptance threshold) to reduce sticky accepts, (3) microbench token-level KL and topk-rank delta, (4) reproduce on a non-quantized spec path as control.

alex: +1. I'd also add a short ablation: run with only prefix-prefetch disabled (speculative still allowed) to check if prefix caching interacts with quantized logits.

maia: agreed. I pushed the quick runner script: `tools/spec_probe.py` — example command:
```
python tools/spec_probe.py --model m3-13b-q30 --decode speculative --prefetch 0.55 --control deterministic --tasks TriviaQA,HotpotQA --seed 42 --out /tmp/spec_probe.json
```
Outputs per-example KL, topk ranks, and speculative accept flags.

dina: I'll re-run the 70B quant variant later today with the same script and attach the per-example diffs. expect longer runtime but important to see scale effects.

ravi: can someone dump a handful of failing examples into `/shared/spec_fail_samples/`? want them for eval set and quick human checks.

maia: done, copied 50 examples (multi-hop where EM dropped) at `/shared/spec_fail_samples/3788881234/`. includes model traces and per-token KL.

alex: quick thought — before we tune heuristic alpha, let's try a soft-accept threshold (e.g., accept if p_spec >= p_ref * 0.9) to reduce brittle switches. might recover some EM without much latency regression. small experiment to run in-canary.

maia: noted. action items: @alex run soft-accept ablation on canary (deadline EOD), @dina reproduce on 70B quant and upload logs, @ravi wire failing examples into eval harness and add a smoke test asserting EM drop < 1.5pp for canary rollouts. I'll iterate on analysis and upload plots to the thread.

ops-bot: reminder — please sign-off for canary changes in #eng-releases if moving beyond pool 4. :gear:

maia: thanks — will update here once the ablations finish. :eyes:
